close_reason: Not a real bug: chain.last().ok_or() is harmless defensive programming. check_inputs prevents the empty-chain case but the guard is not wrong, just redundant. Below threshold for change.
description: In validate_path (line 386), 'chain.last().ok_or(Error::NoTrustedPath)?' is unreachable because check_inputs at line 370 already returns Err(NoTrustedPath) when chain is empty. The .ok_or guard is dead code that creates a false sense of safety and will confuse maintainers who later add branches between check_inputs and this line. Fix: replace with chain.last().expect("check_inputs guarantees non-empty") or, better, assert_debug or extract the non-empty slice as a typed invariant.
title: dead chain.last().ok_or() after check_inputs guard
